items.title: The Biggest Mistakes Developers Make When Building AI Agents
items.summary:
AI agents can do more than generate responses—but giving a model tools and autonomy doesn’t automatically make it reliable.

In this Short, an author of Building Specialized AI Systems reveals the biggest mistakes developers make when creating AI agents, from poorly defined goals and unnecessary complexity to weak evaluation, missing guardrails, and insufficient human oversight.

Learn more about Building Specialized AI Systems: https://hubs.la/Q04tZN370

#AIAgents #AgenticAI #LLM #GenerativeAI #AISystems #Shorts

items.title: India’s 11th Largest IT Firm: Inside the ITC Infotech-Happiest Minds Deal | Point Break
items.summary:
ITC Infotech and Happiest Minds are merging to become a top Indian IT services firm. We analyse the deal structure and its market impact.

The consolidation aims to create the 11th-largest company in the Indian IT sector, boasting over Rs 7,000 crore in revenue and a workforce of 19,000 employees. This strategic move signals significant shifts within the domestic technology landscape. The transaction involves ITC Infotech acquiring a 22.1% stake from founder Ashok Sutta for Rs 1,330 crore, which will be followed by a share swap. We examine what this means for the broader IT services merger and the future competitive dynamics of the industry.

In this episode of Point Break, Antara Gupta sits down with Praveen Bhadada, CEO & MD of Neovay Global, and Piyush Pandey, Senior VP of Institutional Equity Research at Centrum India. They analyse the strategic and financial mechanics of the merger, valuation multiples without control premiums, vendor consolidation pressures across Fortune 2000 enterprises, leadership integration risks, and the future of mid-tier IT services in the AI era.

✅ Chess League: Test your skills → https://chess.analyticsindiamag.com/

1:35 Strategic rationale: Combining SAP, PLM, and digital engineering capabilities
5:50 Why Ashok Soota and Happiest Minds chose this consolidation moment
8:21 Share swap mechanics: 25:81 ratio and valuation without control premium

items.title: Post-Train Qwen 27B: Beyond Harness Engineering
items.summary:
Training LLMs Inside Evolving Worlds.
The New Engine Behind Agentic RL.
Terminal-Universe Meets Environment Evolution.
AI Rebuilds - and Evolves - Its Own RL Worlds.
Qwen 27B Learns From Self-Evolving RL Worlds. 

Two new ArXiv pre-prints show how old agent trajectories can be reconstructed into executable training worlds, then evolved into progressively harder, verifier-checked RL curricula. The goal is no longer merely to improve the agent harness: it is to generate the adaptive learning signal that directly post-trains the LLM itself.

items.title: India’s AI Boom: 32% of Workers Are Changing How They Work | Ft. President Microsoft India
items.summary:
How is AI in India shaping the future of enterprise? Microsoft India President Puneet Chandhok breaks down the latest findings.

We sit down at Microsoft's Bengaluru office to discuss the Work Trend Index. This report offers a clear look at how professionals and teams across the country are adopting new technology within their workflows. It provides a realistic view of the current state of enterprise AI adoption.

Understanding these patterns is essential for anyone leading teams or building products. By analysing how generative AI is used on the ground, business leaders can better prepare for shifts in the local market. Puneet Chandhok shares insights on these trends and what they mean for the broader ecosystem.
